Takes Steadmo\'s buttons straight to CamAPS FX\'s meal, Boost and Ease-off

After you tap a meal, Boost or Ease-off button in Steadmo, this goes to that screen in CamAPS FX, and types a meal\'s carbs in. You confirm them, check the bolus and deliver it in CamAPS FX; Steadmo never delivers insulin. It sees and taps CamAPS FX\'s screens only, no other app\'s.
